title: What if you only had 48 hours to live? (Short)

shots.text: You have forty-eight hours to live.
Plan A: never sleep. Bad plan.
After 24 hours awake, your brain works like a blood alcohol of point one. Over the legal limit.
Plan B: Tokyo. Ten hours in the air. Each way. You'd die watching an airplane movie.
But science says you wouldn't want to go anyway.
When time feels short, people stop wanting new things. They want the people they already love.
Plan C: buy a sports car. For one day. That's just a very expensive rental.
In one famous experiment, people who spent even five dollars on someone else were happier by the end of the day than people who spent it on themselves.
And over a lifetime, our biggest regrets are the things we never did. Never said.
So you call your mom. You call the friend you stopped talking to. You say everything.
Researchers in Vancouver even found that some dying patients' brains still responded to sound, hours before the end. So keep talking.
Here's the twist. Your clock is already running. You just can't see the numbers.
Who would you call first? Send this to them.
